why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: (1.21.8, re-reviewed for EpicCoreAPI#32 from the neoforge-21.8.54 sources and javap of neoforge-21.8.54-merged.jar) The inherited verdict (renderClouds HEAD moved to CloudRendererMixin, renderSky TAIL to the AfterSky GlobalSkyboxHook, same effect) was wrong on 1.21.8 in all three points of the issue, so both handlers are restored in this overlay. renderClouds HEAD: lambda$addCloudsPass$7 calls DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds(ClientLevel,int,float,double,double,double,Matrix4f) and runs CloudRenderer.render only when that returns false, so gating CloudRenderer alone never skipped a dimension that draws its own clouds; eca$skipOccludingClouds (require = 1) cancels the lambda at that invoke, which is where 1.21.1's HEAD sat. renderLevel adds the clouds pass after addMainPass (entities, where renderEntity sets CloudGate.occlude) and addParticlesPass, so the flag is final when it runs; CloudRendererMixin stays as a harmless second gate. renderSky TAIL: GameRenderer.renderLevel passes !isFoggyAt as renderLevel's last boolean, and renderLevel calls addSkyPass only when it is true; addSkyPass adds no pass for POWDER_SNOW/LAVA, a sky-blocking effect or SkyType NONE; AfterSky is posted only inside lambda$addSkyPass$13 and also after a custom renderSky returned true. 1.21.1's renderSky reached its TAIL in a foggy dimension and returned before it after a custom renderSky, so the old hook drew in the wrong cases both ways. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass (require = 1) adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main just before the addMainPass invoke (after the sky pass when there is one); it is skipped when lambda$addSkyPass$13's renderSky(ClientLevel,int,float,Matrix4f,Camera,Runnable) returned true (eca$recordCustomSky, require = 1) and, on a frame with no sky pass (render-sky flag false for a foggy/boss-fog dimension, SkyType NONE, a sky-blocking effect, lava/powder snow, where 1.21.8 never calls renderSky but 1.21.1 still asked it before the TAIL), when the dimension's DimensionSpecialEffects class overrides renderSky at all (the declaring class of its renderSky is neither DimensionSpecialEffects nor NeoForge's IDimensionSpecialEffectsExtension default, which 1.21.8 still has with the one-Matrix4f signature; cached per class); GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned makes the AfterSky handler stand down. Fog: 1.21.8 has no FogParameters; FogRenderer writes one world fog buffer (FogMode.WORLD, the sky end distances are fields of it) that GameRenderer passes to renderLevel as its GpuBufferSlice, and vanilla's sky pass draws after RenderSystem.setShaderFog(that slice), so the new pass sets the same slice. Double rotation confirmed real on 1.21.8: renderLevel does matrix4fstack.mul(frustumMatrix) before the frame graph, LegacyGl and RenderType draws write RenderSystem.getModelViewMatrix() (that stack) into DynamicTransforms as ModelViewMat, and AfterSky.getModelViewMatrix() is that same frustumMatrix, which the old hook also put on its PoseStack; render() now starts from identity. renderEntity HEAD/RETURN, isSectionCompiled HEAD and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay.

why: deletes overriding method(s) getGLVersion, loadingOverlay, positionWindow, setupMinecraftWindow: whatever they did is gone -- port each to the new API, or say why vanilla no longer needs it
reviewed: The provider's only effect is its static initialiser (kept), which FML 9 still runs because it instantiates every ImmediateWindowProvider service; the deleted getGLVersion/loadingOverlay/positionWindow/setupMinecraftWindow were inert stubs of methods FML 9's interface no longer has.
